dt.desc: How current and complete the numbers in this dashboard are.
dt.l1: Every number comes from a local snapshot taken at the last scan, not from Gmail right now.
dt.l2: Mail that arrived, moved or was deleted after the scan is not reflected.
dt.l3: Types such as newsletter or promotion are inferred from sender and Gmail labels; they are not guaranteed.
dt.l4: No subjects or message bodies are stored, so nothing here depends on the content of your mail.
dt.l5: Cleanup figures are recommendations and ledger records, not a statement of what is in Gmail today.
dt.limits.desc: Limits that come from working offline on a snapshot.
dt.limits.title: What this dashboard can and cannot tell you
dt.maint.hint: checks the index, backups and sync records from a terminal; it only reports and changes nothing.
dt.p1: The server listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1) and answers only requests that carry this session's token.
dt.p2: The database is opened read-only. This page has no way to change your index, your mailbox or your labels.
dt.p3: Nothing is loaded from the internet: no fonts, scripts, images or analytics.
dt.p4: Sender addresses and label names are hidden unless you started the server with the matching option.
dt.privacy.desc: How this dashboard handles your data.
dt.privacy.title: Privacy
dt.sync.note: Two separate freshness checks: the scan (a full pass over the mailbox, stale after 7 days) and the sync (keeps the index current for cleanup plans, stale after 24 hours). One can be fresh while the other is stale; they are not merged.
dt.sync.note.label: Scan vs. sync
dt.title: Index and data freshness

explain.ADDRESSES_MASKED_BY_DEFAULT: Sender addresses are masked unless you start the server with --reveal-senders.
explain.AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFIED_LOCALLY: The audit chain was checked locally when this was computed.
explain.BASIS_INFERRED: Basis: inferred - built on classification rules.
explain.BASIS_MIXED: Basis: a mix of observed counts and inferred judgements.
explain.BASIS_OBSERVED: Basis: observed - counted directly from the local index.
explain.CLASSIFICATION_IS_INFERRED: Types come from classification rules applied to sender and Gmail labels; they are inferred, not certain.
explain.CLASSIFIED_IS_CURRENT_RULES_ONLY: Only classifications made with the current rules count as classified.
explain.CONFIDENCE_IS_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH: Confidence is the strength of the evidence, not a probability.
explain.COUNTED_ONCE_UNDER_FIRST_TYPE: A message with two compatible types is counted once, under the first in the fixed type order.
explain.DATA_AGE_FROM_LAST_SCAN: Data age is measured from the last completed scan.
explain.DOMAIN_NOT_MASKED: Domains are shown; only the part before the @ of an address is masked.
explain.DOMINANT_TYPE_IS_INFERRED: The dominant type of a sender is inferred from classification.
explain.ELIGIBLE_IS_NOT_A_DECISION: Eligible means a candidate for a recommendation, not a decision.
explain.EMPTY_MONTHS_SHOWN_AS_ZERO: Months without messages are shown as zero.
explain.LABEL_NAMES_HIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT: Label names are hidden unless you start the server with --reveal-names.
explain.LAST_MONTH_MAY_BE_INCOMPLETE: The month of the last scan may be incomplete.
explain.LOCAL_LEDGER_NOT_GMAIL_STATE: These are local ledger records, not the current state of Gmail.
explain.M5_ANALYSIS_READ_ONLY: Computed by the read-only label analysis.
explain.MONTHLY_BY_MESSAGE_DATE: Months follow each message's own date.
explain.NOTHING_APPLIED_OR_CREATED: Nothing is applied, created or sent.
explain.NO_MESSAGE_IDS_OR_LABELS: No message ids or label names are shown.
explain.NO_SUBJECTS_OR_BODIES: No subjects or bodies are used.
explain.PROTECTED_MESSAGES_EXCLUDED: Protected and potentially important messages are excluded.
explain.SNAPSHOT_NOT_LIVE: This is a snapshot from the last scan, not live Gmail.
explain.SYNC_FROM_LOCAL_RECORDS: Synchronization status is read from local sync records; Gmail itself is not checked.

cx.tab.label: Cleanup sections
cx.intro.title: A read-only view of local records
cx.intro.body: Everything on this page is read from this computer's own records. The dashboard never approves, reserves, runs, confirms, aborts, undoes or reconciles anything, and it never contacts Gmail. Live Gmail operations are disabled in this build, and real Gmail acceptance has not taken place.
cx.intro.cli: Approvals, execution and undo stay in the owner-operated command line (see the cleanup guide). Refreshing this page only re-reads the local records.
cx.life.title: Cleanup lifecycle
cx.life.desc: Discovery, review, plan, approval, execution, then recovery or undo. The counts come from local records only.
cx.ss.NOT_STORED: Done in the command line; not stored
cx.empty.title: No cleanup data yet
cx.empty.body: Nothing has been scanned or recorded locally, so there is nothing to show. Use the command line to scan the mailbox first.
cx.k.note: "Recorded" means the local journal says so; the dashboard does not check Gmail. A possible candidate is a suggestion to review, not a statement that the mail is unnecessary.
cx.warn.title: Please note:
cx.dw.INDEX_EMPTY: The local index holds no messages.
cx.dw.INDEX_PARTIAL: The index is incomplete, so nothing is recommended until a full scan finishes.
cx.dw.SOME_SIZES_UNKNOWN: Some sizes are unknown, so volumes are lower estimates.
cx.dw.NO_GROUP_REACHES_MIN_SIZE: No sender group reaches the minimum size for listing.
cx.split.title: Where things stand
cx.split.desc: Plans, executions and reversal plans by state. A state is a local record, not a Gmail check.
cx.dis.title: Possible cleanup candidates
cx.dis.desc: Groups of mail the existing cleanup rules already find eligible. Suggestions to review, never a decision.
cx.dis.maybe: These are possibilities to review, not statements that any mail is unnecessary. Nothing is planned or changed from here.
cx.dis.none.title: Nothing indexed yet
cx.dis.none.body: The local index has no messages, so there is nothing to discover. Scan the mailbox from the command line first.
cx.dis.nogroups.title: No group is large enough to list
cx.dis.nogroups.body: Either nothing is eligible right now or every group is below the listing size.
cx.dis.caption: Candidate groups by sender domain
cx.dis.caution: that review rules this sender out
cx.dis.why.title: Why are these suggested?
cx.why.IN_INBOX: The message is in the inbox.
cx.why.NO_HARD_PROTECTION: It carries no hard protection (starred, sent, draft, trash, spam or one of your protection rules).
cx.why.NOT_UNREAD_NOT_IMPORTANT: It is read and not marked important.
cx.why.NO_ATTENTION_SIGNAL: No signal marks it as possibly needing your attention.
cx.why.CLASSIFIED_BY_RULE: A rule classified it with at least medium confidence as promotional, social or a newsletter.
cx.dis.small: {groups} smaller group(s) with {messages} message(s) are not listed.
cx.dis.reasons.title: What needs review or is protected
cx.dis.reasons.desc: Counts by reason. A message can have several reasons.
cx.dis.na: Not applicable (not in the inbox or too recent)
cx.plans.title: Cleanup plans
cx.plans.desc: Immutable plans exactly as recorded locally, with their review and approval status.
cx.plans.info.title: Informational only.
cx.plans.info.body: A plan or approval shown here is a local record. An approved plan has NOT been executed unless an execution is listed for it. The dashboard cannot create, change, approve or run a plan.
cx.plans.cli: Plans are created, reviewed and approved with the owner-operated commands (cleanup preview, cleanup plan create, cleanup plan review, cleanup approve).
cx.plans.caption: Cleanup plans
cx.plans.none.title: No plans yet
cx.plans.none.body: No cleanup plan has been created. Plans appear here after the owner creates them from the command line.
cx.ex.title: Executions
cx.ex.desc: Progress of every recorded archive execution, slice by slice.
cx.ex.info.title: A record of what happened.
cx.ex.info.body: An execution counts as completed only when no item is left unresolved. There is no run, continue, retry or abort control here: those steps are done with typed confirmations in the command line, and live execution is disabled in this build.
cx.ex.none.title: No executions recorded
cx.ex.none.body: No plan has been executed. This is expected while live operations are disabled.
cx.ex.done.title: Completed.
cx.ex.done.body: Every item has a final recorded outcome and none is unresolved.
cx.ex.slice.caption: Slices of this execution
cx.ex.times: Created {created} · last change {changed} · last audit entry {audit}
cx.ex.next.INTERRUPTED: The run was cut short. It is never resumed automatically. Settle uncertain items read-only with the recovery command in the command line.
cx.ex.next.RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Some outcomes are unknown. They stay unknown until a fresh observation settles them (command line; disabled in this build).
cx.ex.next.AWAITING_CONTINUATION: The next slice needs its own typed confirmation, or the execution can be abandoned (command line).
cx.ex.next.PREPARED: Reserved but not started. Run it with a typed confirmation or abandon it (command line).
cx.ex.next.PARTIAL: Some items were not applied or are unresolved. Nothing continues from here; review the counts above.
cx.ex.next.COMPLETED_WITH_OPEN_ITEMS: Finished, but some items are unresolved. Settle them read-only in the command line.
cx.ex.next.FAILED: No item was recorded as applied. Review the counts above.
cx.ex.next.ABORTED: Abandoned by the owner. Unattempted items were never sent.
cx.ex.next.RUNNING: A run holds an active lease according to the local record.
cx.rv.title: Undo and reversal plans
cx.rv.desc: Bulk reversal plans and single-item undo records, read from the local audit log.
cx.rv.info.title: Read-only.
cx.rv.info.body: A reversal only ever puts the inbox label back on a message this tool archived. It is planned, approved and run in the command line, one bounded slice at a time; live undo is disabled in this build. There is no restore control here.
cx.rv.none.title: No reversal plans or undo records
cx.rv.none.body: Nothing has been undone and no reversal plan exists.
cx.rv.of: Source execution {exec} · {items} item(s) · {done} of {total} slice(s) done
cx.rv.single: Single-item undo records (not part of a plan)
cx.rv.bad.title: Inconsistent record.
cx.rv.bad.body: The audit log for this plan is not in an allowed sequence, so nothing can be run from it. It needs the owner's manual review.
cx.rv.next.PLANNED: Waiting for the owner's typed approval (command line).
cx.rv.next.APPROVED: Approved; each slice needs its own typed confirmation to run (command line; disabled in this build).
cx.rv.next.IN_PROGRESS: A slice is recorded as running.
cx.rv.next.INTERRUPTED: A slice never finished. It is not resumed; settle uncertain items read-only or abandon the plan (command line).
cx.rv.next.AWAITING_CONTINUATION: The next slice needs its own typed confirmation (command line).
cx.rv.next.COMPLETED: Finished. Review the counts for anything uncertain.
cx.rv.next.STOPPED: Stopped and not continued. Settle uncertain items read-only; remaining items were never attempted (command line).
cx.rv.next.ABORTED: Abandoned by the owner; items already restored stay restored.
cx.rec.title: Recovery and safety
cx.rec.desc: Work that is unresolved or waiting for the owner, from the local records.
cx.rec.clear.title: Nothing needs attention.
cx.rec.clear.body: No interrupted execution, unknown or conflicting outcome, inconsistent record or reversal plan is waiting.
cx.rec.some.title: Some work is waiting for the owner.
cx.rec.some.one: {n} item needs attention. This is a calm status, not an emergency.
cx.rec.some.other: {n} items need attention. This is a calm status, not an emergency.
cx.rec.caption: Work needing attention
cx.rec.note: This page never reconciles anything. An unknown outcome stays unknown until a fresh, read-only observation settles it, and refreshing the page does not change it.
cx.rec.cli: Settling uncertain work uses the recovery command with its read-only reconcile option; it is disabled in this build.
cx.next.RECONCILE: Settle uncertain items read-only (recovery command, reconcile option; disabled in this build).
cx.next.CONFIRM_OR_ABORT: Confirm the next slice with a typed phrase, or abandon the execution (command line).
cx.next.RUN_OR_ABORT: Run it with a typed confirmation or abandon it (command line).
cx.next.REVIEW: Review the counts; nothing continues from here.
cx.next.REVIEW_CONFLICT: Review by hand; a conflict is never presented as a success.
cx.next.APPROVE: Approve it with a typed phrase (command line) or leave it.
cx.next.ABORT_OR_NEW_PLAN: Abandon the plan or create a new one (command line).
cx.next.RUN_OR_EXPIRE: Run it before it expires, or let the authorization lapse (command line).
cx.stage.APPROVAL_MISSING: Marked approved, but no approval record
cx.stage.APPROVAL_INVALID: Approval record not valid (needs the owner's review)
cx.rec.chain.title: The audit log needs manual investigation.
cx.rec.chain.body: The local audit chain failed its integrity check, so the records on this page cannot be fully trusted and no all-clear is shown. Nothing is repaired or rewritten automatically and the dashboard cannot do it. Investigate from the command line (cleanup audit verify) and keep a copy of the index file before any manual step.
